summary: Fixed the four bugs the unit tests show (leap-year February, inclusive used days, percentage-before-amount order discounts, one rounding per tax group), the three the reconciliation shows (largest remainder shares, amount discounts in the currency exponent, period starts from the anchor) and two found by review against the docs (tier minimums compared as numbers when the catalog writes them as text, valid lines of a refused credit request no longer counted by later requests).
